<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3807">kha <expan>cig</expan></rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs></note><note type="editorial">Identified as 'bre shes rab 'bar rather than gtsang pa 'bre sgur (ID.3872), as the latter is referred to as "gtsang 'bre"</note> brtan pa thob 
par bya ba'i don du mkhyen pa gsum gyi chos rim can du sgom pa'o zhes zer ba mi 'thad de 
gzhi shes kyi chos rim can du sgom pa'ang der thal lo || 

de 'dod na nyan rang  <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="25b8"/> la mthar gyis pa yod par thal lo |   </seg></TEI>
